snp1.2:1.1: “I have prepared cooked rice and fresh milk,”
snp1.2:1.3: “I stay constantly at the shore of the great river,
snp1.2:1.4: “I have a closed hut with a fire kindled;
snp1.2:1.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:2.1: “I have no anger and no corruption,”
snp1.2:2.3: “I stay one night at the shore of the great river,
snp1.2:2.4: “I have an open hut with the fire extinguished;
snp1.2:2.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:3.3: “In the marshes and meadows where the cattle roam,
snp1.2:3.4: “When it rained in the past, they could endure;
snp1.2:3.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:4.3: “It crossed over to the far shore, it went past the deluge;
snp1.2:4.4: “I have no need of a raft;
snp1.2:4.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:5.3: “For a long time, she has been a pleasant co-resident,
snp1.2:5.4: “I have never heard anything evil from her;
snp1.2:5.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:6.3: “For a long time, it has been thoroughly developed and well-trained,
snp1.2:6.4: “No evil can be found in me;
snp1.2:6.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:7.1: “I have a servant that I hired myself,”
snp1.2:7.4: “I have never heard anything evil from them;
snp1.2:7.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:8.1: “I am not the servant of anyone,”
snp1.2:8.3: “I travel the entire world with what I have gained,
snp1.2:8.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:9.1: “There is a cow and a suckling calf,”
snp1.2:9.3: “There is the herd-mother with her offspring,
snp1.2:9.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:10.1: “There is no cow and no suckling calf,”
snp1.2:10.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:11.1: “The post is firmly entrenched and does not wobble,”
snp1.2:11.3: “The ropes are made of new and well-made twine,
snp1.2:11.4: “It is not possible for the calves to break them;
snp1.2:11.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:12.1: “Like a bull that has broken its bonds,”
snp1.2:12.3: “Like an elephant that has burst through rotten vines,
snp1.2:12.4: “I will never again enter a womb;
snp1.2:12.5: “So if the angels wish, they can make it rain.”
snp1.2:13.1: Flooding both the low ground and the high ground,
snp1.2:13.2: a great raincloud poured down rain.
snp1.2:13.3: After hearing the rain from the angels,
snp1.2:14.1: “It is a gain for us, and not a small one,
snp1.2:15.1: “I am a cow-herd, and I listen,
snp1.2:15.2: “I will live the spiritual life following the Sublime One,
snp1.2:16.1: “One who has children delights because of their children,”
snp1.2:16.3: “One who has cattle delights because of their cattle,
snp1.2:16.4: “Possessions are the delight of a person,
snp1.2:16.5: “One who has no possessions has no delight.”
snp1.2:17.1: “One who has children sorrows because of their children,”
snp1.2:17.3: “One who has cattle sorrows because of their cattle,
snp1.2:17.4: “Possessions are the the sorrow of a person,
snp1.2:17.5: “One who has no possessions has no sorrow.”
